crossRefs.note: Yahweh, how my adversaries have increased! Many are those who rise up against me.
Many there are who say of my soul, “There is no help for him in God.”
You allowed men to ride over our heads. We went through fire and through water, but you brought us to the place of…
I have seen servants on horses, and princes walking like servants on the earth.

people.name: Beth-merhak
people.line: Place near Jerusalem where David stayed during Absalom's revolt.

translations.web: The king went out, and all the people after him; and they stayed in Beth Merhak.
translations.bsb: So the king set out with all the people following him. He stopped at the last house,
translations.kjv: And the king went forth, and all the people after him, and tarried in a place that was far off.
translations.asv: And the king went forth, and all the people after him; and they tarried in Beth-merhak.
